name: The Babysitter
source: When you get a job to mind a child at a house in a remote suburb, what you find over the course of the evening, and the decisions you have to make, will test your resolve, your beliefs, and your sanity.
translation: 你接下了一份照看孩子的工作，地点在偏远郊区的一户人家。那天晚上，你逐渐发现的一切，以及不得不作出的决定，将考验你的决心、信念与理智。
